intro: I am interested in the Data Engineer role with Cutsforth. My background aligns strongly with Python data engineering, telemetry and machine-health-style data, time-series forecasting, operational analytics, stakeholder reporting, and ML-supporting pipeline workflows.
body: At Citi, I built automated Python and Pandas pipelines ingesting telemetry from more than 6,000 infrastructure endpoints and developed time-series forecasting models using Prophet and scikit-learn to predict capacity bottlenecks months ahead. That work involved feature preparation, historical data retention, validation checks, SQL/Oracle reporting structures, dashboards, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Cutsforth role's focus on complex datasets, machine health, time-series analysis, forecasting, anomaly detection, data pipelines, and operational outcomes maps well to my capacity forecasting and telemetry analytics background. I have worked extensively with infrastructure and application health signals through BMC TrueSight, CA APM, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, and related reporting workflows, turning raw monitoring data into actionable operational insight.

For production AI/ML deployment and Azure ML platform depth, I would be careful and transparent: I bring strong Python, forecasting, data pipeline, model-support, and monitoring experience, plus active cloud/AI learning, but I would not overstate deep Azure ML platform ownership. I can contribute immediately on pipeline design, feature engineering, forecasting datasets, monitoring, documentation, cross-functional communication, and operational analytics.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to help Cutsforth turn industrial and operational time-series data into reliable pipelines, models, and insights that improve decision-making.
